extDescription.message: Keeps drag selections inside the text block where they started, reducing accidental jumps to unrelated page text.

popupSubtitle.message: Prevents text selections from jumping to unrelated parts of the page.

modeDifferenceNote.message: Note: the three modes are easiest to compare when selecting multi-line text.

modeSmartDesc.message: Feels natural nearby, and keeps the selection inside the block when you move farther away.

modeNearestDesc.message: Stops at the text position nearest the pointer.

modeBlockDesc.message: Stops at the edge of the paragraph or heading where the selection started.

altBypassNote.message: Hold Alt when starting a drag to temporarily disable the limit and select across multiple blocks.

sensitiveNote.message: Automatically pauses near password, payment-card, and authentication-code fields.

privacyNote.message: Runs entirely on your device. Page content and form input are never stored or sent.

diagnosticsDescription.message: Keeps the latest 200 actions and pause reasons in this page's memory. Excludes page text, selected text, URLs and input values.

diagnosticsEnabled.message: Recording. Close this popup and use the page. Show the logs on this page after the issue occurs.

diagnosticsDisabled.message: Diagnostics are off. Recorded events have been erased.

diagnosticsNotRecording.message: Recording is off, so there is no failure history. Enable diagnostic logging, close this popup and reproduce the issue.

diagnosticsEmpty.message: Recording is on but the log is empty. Close this popup, use the page and show logs after the issue occurs.

diagnosticsConfigured.message: Diagnostics are configured on. Show logs to check recording on this page.

diagnosticsNotConfirmed.message: The preference was saved, but this page did not confirm it. Reload the page, then check recording again.

diagnosticsReady.message: Logs for this page are ready to copy and share.

diagnosticsUnavailable.message: Logs are unavailable on this page. Open a regular web page, reload it and try again.

diagnosticsSaveFailed.message: Could not save the diagnostic logging preference.

diagnosticsCopyFailed.message: Could not copy. Copy the selected log text manually.
